title: Producer and consumer
description:
Pass loaded data from a loading thread to the game thread through a bounded queue.

```
loader: loaded tile 1..10
game:   used tile 1..10 in order
queue never held more than 3
```
hints: `pop` returns false when the queue is empty and closed, which ends the consumer's loop.
requirements: A queue with a capacity of 3 protected by a `std::mutex`, with two `std::condition_variable`s (not full, not empty).
The producer waits when full; the consumer waits when empty.
A "done" flag lets the consumer stop after the last item.
stretch: Use a Windows event and a critical section instead, to compare the APIs.
